summary: Dependency-confusion lure exfiltrates host identifiers via install-time beacon
details: react-bootstrap-table-next-bg@9.9.9 is a dependency-confusion squat on the react-bootstrap-table-next name, published at an inflated 9.9.9 version to win resolution against internal pins. package.json declares both preinstall and postinstall hooks that run `node beacon.js`, which issues an HTTP GET to the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint http://100.24.177.136/cb with query parameters carrying the installer's hostname, OS username, current working directory, and platform. Installation on any machine that resolves this public name causes those host identifiers to be transmitted in cleartext to the attacker-controlled endpoint, and the lifecycle-script mechanism itself gives the publisher arbitrary code execution on the installer's host at install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
